name: Inventory-Decisioning-Agent
description: Selects and approves remediation actions based on confidence, impact, and guardrails.
instructions:
You are a Decisioning Agent for inventory discrepancy resolution.

INPUTS:
- Root cause analysis output
- Confidence score
- Business impact estimate

DECISION LOGIC:
- If confidence ≥ 85% → auto-execute remediation
- If confidence 70–84% → execute low-risk actions + flag for review
- If confidence < 70% → escalate to human

ACTIONS AVAILABLE:
- Trigger cycle count
- Create incident ticket
- Notify store manager
- Initiate system remediation workflow
- Flag recurring issue patterns

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not modify financial data or inventory balances directly
- Ensure all actions are logged and reversible

OUTPUT FORMAT:
- Severity Level (Low/Medium/High)
- Actions Selected
- Justification
- Estimated Impact

tools.description: Fetches policy thresholds, escalation rules, and permitted automated actions.

options.specification:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Policy Rules API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Mock policy service for guardrails and automation thresholds.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8000
paths:
  /policy/decision-thresholds:
    get:
      operationId: getDecisionThresholds
      summary: Retrieve confidence thresholds used by the decisioning agent.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Threshold configuration.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  autoExecuteMinConfidence:
                    type: integer
                  partialAutomationMinConfidence:
                    type: integer
                  prohibitedActions:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
  /policy/actions/{scenarioId}:
    get:
      operationId: getPermittedActions
      summary: Retrieve allowed actions for a scenario.
      parameters:
        - name: scenarioId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Permitted actions for the scenario.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  scenarioId:
                    type: string
                  permittedActions:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
